results.title: Share a Coding Agent Session | Lody
results.snippet: Lody can still export a conversation as Markdown when you only need a record. That is a different action: Copy Conversations. Copying a session URL without sharing the session also does not grant team access — the link still works for the owner. Handoff is a team-workspace action.

results.title: [Feature Request] Treat agent-opened sessions as supervised workers unless they are an explicit handoff · Issue #529 · LodyAI/Lody
results.snippet: Supervised work stays on the current Session. A panel lists opened workers with count, status, and a short result. Summaries, unread, and alerts attach to the parent. Finished workers can be settled out of the active list without deleting. Handoff is the explicit path that creates a peer Session the user means to own.

results.title: How to Share a Claude Code Session with Your Team (Handoff, Not Just a Link) | Lody
results.snippet: Lore is honest about what it is: a viewer, and sometimes a way to start a new run from distilled context. Lody is the other job — invite someone into the existing session. The full comparison, including SpecStory and the permission model, is in Share a Coding Agent Session. Handoff is a team-workspace action.
